payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the proposed multimodal NER (MNER) model learns from both text and images, utilizing a modality attention module to integrate visual and textual information effectively.

claims.text: The MNER model incorporates both image and text for named entity recognition, demonstrating that it learns from both modalities.
The modality attention module in the MNER model selectively amplifies relevant visual contexts while processing textual information, indicating a learning mechanism from both modalities.
